sources.title: SuperQwen3.8-27b-abliterated-NVFP4-DGX-Spark - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A single-DGX-Spark release tuned for fast C1 decode without trading away the model's multimodal, tool, reasoning, or long-context behavior. This is the one-box performance edition of Jiunsong/SuperQwen3.8-27b-abliterated. It fits and serves on one NVIDIA DGX Spark with TP=1.

sources.title: Thread By @jun_song - SuperQwen3.8-27b-abliterated is now...
sources.snippet: SuperQwen3.8-27b-abliterated is now live and open for everyone - Uncensored for freedom - Broken weight from abliteration fixed with agents swarm - fixed overthinking problem - 1M context, Multimodal Sorry about the late release. Super-tune takes much more time than normal abliterated models, because fixing weights and eval takes about a week.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored GGUF: Abliterated Local Build
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.8 27B uncensored GGUF is a real download, and the build to start with is Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF — published on Hugging Face on August 16, 2026 as the llama.cpp-native sibling of our abliterated FP8 release.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B AEON Uncensored: How This Abliteration Actually Works
sources.snippet: A community abliteration of Qwen3.8-27B explains its KL-drift methodology, judge-based refusal testing, and how to run the model via vLLM.
